trigger: The caller wants financial information about their account: an invoice, a payment, a balance, a charge they are disputing, or a credit. Run this before discussing any of it. Run it once per call.

steps.instruction: Tell the caller only verified person can have access to this information, you need to confirm a few details before you can look at the account.
Ask for the email address on the account. Take whatever they say, including if they spell it out.
Read the address back to confirm you heard it correctly, spelling the part before the @ and the domain out letter by letter, and naming any hyphen or dot explicitly.
Ask for the phone number on the account. Any format they give is fine.
Ask for their date of birth.
Ask for for the customer id
Send all three answers together. Do not reformat, correct or complete any of them.

fallback.instruction: Tell the caller you could not complete the check just now, and offer to have a colleague call them back. Do not say why, just that could not.

steps.instruction: Thank them briefly and move straight on to what they called about.

fallback.instruction: Tell the caller you were not able to confirm their identity and that you will pass them to a colleague who can help. Never say why.
